Unfortunately I used these products only twice and I dealt with a severe flare up of rosacea & eczema. So now this cream sits in my plastic tub that collects products I have purchased yet can't use. I can't comment on long-term effectiveness or if the products work as claimed by marketing jargon. One other thing. WHAT is with the horrible scent of this product line? [This review is written as part of a promotion.] This product goes on well. It's smooth, not sticky, and feels good on the skin. It did not cause me any dryness or peeling, and I have fairly sensitive skin. But I would not reach for this product as a retinol. If you look at the product information, nowhere on it does it tell you the percentage of retinol. Which is a huge red flag for me. Additionally, in the ingredients list, Retinyl Palmitate is the eighth ingredient and Retinol is the eleventh. Meaning, you aren't getting a lot of retinol. You are however getting plenty of kojic acid (sixth ingredient) and niacinamide (second ingredient). I'm not upset about this, I'd rather people use kojic acid and niacinamide for dark spots, moisture, and skin health. As they do way more for your skin that retinol does, but this is a RETINOL rapid repair and dark spot treatment, which is misleading. That's why I've marked this as three stars. Not because it doesn't work, or I dislike the product, but because this is a misleading product. This product kept my skin happy. It didn't lighten any dark spots dramatically, but it did keep my skin moisturized and didn't irritate it. Overall, I like the product. But lets be real, the retinol isn't doing anything. The niacinamide and squalene are keeping skin moisturized and the KOJIC ACID is helping with dark spots. The desperately need to change the name of this product. And until such time, I'm forced to give three stars as it is currently misl
